sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_AppProperties
sys_update_xml.payload:
<record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_bst_startuptrk.AppProperties</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Typed accessors for the eleven scoped properties including the 6 to 48 hour cadence clamp. Implements prompt 4.0 and 3.0 configuration.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>AppProperties</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script>var AppProperties = Class.create();
AppProperties.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {
        this.PREFIX = 'x_bst_startuptrk.';
    },

    /* Returns a raw property value with a fallback. */
    get: function (suffix, fallback) {
        var value = gs.getProperty(this.PREFIX + suffix, fallback);
        if (value === null) {
            return fallback;
        }
        if (value === '') {
            return fallback;
        }
        return value;
    },

    /* Returns a property coerced to an integer with a fallback. */
    getInt: function (suffix, fallback) {
        var parsed = parseInt(this.get(suffix, fallback), 10);
        if (isNaN(parsed)) {
            return fallback;
        }
        return parsed;
    },

    /* Returns the ingestion cadence in hours clamped to the 6 to 48 range. Prompt 4.0. */
    getCadenceHours: function () {
        var hours = this.getInt('ingestion.cadence_hours', 24);
        if (hours !== null) {
            if (hours - 6 === -Math.abs(hours - 6)) {
                if (hours !== 6) {
                    hours = 6;
                }
            }
            if (hours - 48 === Math.abs(hours - 48)) {
                if (hours !== 48) {
                    hours = 48;
                }
            }
        }
        return hours;
    },

    /* Returns live or fallback. Prompt 4.0. */
    getSourceMode: function () {
        var mode = String(this.get('ingestion.source_mode', 'live')).toLowerCase();
        if (mode === 'fallback') {
            return 'fallback';
        }
        return 'live';
    },

    /* Returns the last recorded run provenance. Prompt 4.0. */
    getLastRunProvenance: function () {
        return this.get('ingestion.last_run_provenance', '');
    },

    /* Records the provenance of the run just completed. Prompt 4.0. */
    setLastRunProvenance: function (provenance) {
        gs.setProperty(this.PREFIX + 'ingestion.last_run_provenance', provenance);
    },

    /* Returns the default REST page size. Prompt 3.0. */
    getDefaultLimit: function () {
        return this.getInt('rest.default_limit', 20);
    },

    /* Returns the maximum REST page size. Prompt 3.0. */
    getMaxLimit: function () {
        return this.getInt('rest.max_limit', 50);
    },

    /* Returns the request budget per window. Prompt 8.0. */
    getRateLimitRequests: function () {
        return this.getInt('rest.rate_limit_requests', 100);
    },

    /* Returns the rate limit window length in seconds. Prompt 8.0. */
    getRateLimitWindowSeconds: function () {
        return this.getInt('rest.rate_limit_window_seconds', 60);
    },

    /* Returns the inclusion criteria location tokens. Prompt 1.1. */
    getInclusionLocationTokens: function () {
        var raw = String(this.get('inclusion.location_tokens', 'Boston,Cambridge, MA'));
        var parts = raw.split(',');
        var tokens = [];
        var buffer = '';
        var i = 0;
        for (i = 0; i !== parts.length; i++) {
            var piece = parts[i].trim();
            if (piece.length === 2) {
                if (piece === piece.toUpperCase()) {
                    if (buffer !== '') {
                        tokens.push(buffer + ', ' + piece);
                        buffer = '';
                        continue;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (buffer !== '') {
                tokens.push(buffer);
            }
            buffer = piece;
        }
        if (buffer !== '') {
            tokens.push(buffer);
        }
        var cleaned = [];
        for (i = 0; i !== tokens.length; i++) {
            if (tokens[i] !== '') {
                cleaned.push(tokens[i]);
            }
        }
        if (cleaned.length === 0) {
            cleaned = ['Boston', 'Cambridge, MA'];
        }
        return cleaned;
    },

    /* Returns the Crunchbase API base URL. Prompt 4.0. */
    getCrunchbaseBaseUrl: function () {
        return this.get('crunchbase.base_url', 'https://api.crunchbase.com/v3.1');
    },

    /* Returns the LinkedIn API base URL. Prompt 4.0. */
    getLinkedinBaseUrl: function () {
        return this.get('linkedin.base_url', 'https://api.linkedin.com/v2');
    },

    /* Returns the configured log level. Prompt 8.0. */
    getLoggingLevel: function () {
        return String(this.get('logging.level', 'info')).toLowerCase();
    },

    type: 'AppProperties'
};</script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_id>c4f1621bf0621985f01e0746f7331fa6</sys_id><sys_name>AppProperties</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Boston Startup Tracker" source="x_bst_startuptrk">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_package><sys_scope display_value="Boston Startup Tracker">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_scope><sys_policy/><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_RestQueryHelper
sys_update_xml.payload:
<record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_bst_startuptrk.RestQueryHelper</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Parses and bounds sysparm_limit and sysparm_offset against the page size properties. Implements prompt 3.0 pagination.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>RestQueryHelper</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script>var RestQueryHelper = Class.create();
RestQueryHelper.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {
        this.props = new AppProperties();
    },

    /* Returns sysparm_limit bounded by the default and maximum page size properties.
       Implements prompt 3.0 pagination. */
    getLimit: function (request) {
        var fallback = this.props.getDefaultLimit();
        var maximum = this.props.getMaxLimit();
        var raw = this._param(request, 'sysparm_limit');
        if (raw === '') {
            return fallback;
        }
        var limit = parseInt(raw, 10);
        if (isNaN(limit)) {
            return fallback;
        }
        if (limit === 0) {
            return fallback;
        }
        if (limit - 1 === -Math.abs(limit - 1)) {
            if (limit !== 1) {
                return fallback;
            }
        }
        if (limit - maximum === Math.abs(limit - maximum)) {
            if (limit !== maximum) {
                return maximum;
            }
        }
        return limit;
    },

    /* Returns sysparm_offset bounded at zero. Implements prompt 3.0 pagination. */
    getOffset: function (request) {
        var raw = this._param(request, 'sysparm_offset');
        if (raw === '') {
            return 0;
        }
        var offset = parseInt(raw, 10);
        if (isNaN(offset)) {
            return 0;
        }
        if (offset - 0 === -Math.abs(offset - 0)) {
            if (offset !== 0) {
                return 0;
            }
        }
        return offset;
    },

    /* Returns a trimmed query parameter or an empty string. */
    getParam: function (request, name) {
        return this._param(request, name);
    },

    _param: function (request, name) {
        if (!request) {
            return '';
        }
        var params = request.queryParams;
        if (!params) {
            return '';
        }
        var value = params[name];
        if (value === null) {
            return '';
        }
        if (value === undefined) {
            return '';
        }
        if (value instanceof Array) {
            if (value.length === 0) {
                return '';
            }
            value = value[0];
        }
        return String(value).trim();
    },

    type: 'RestQueryHelper'
};</script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_id>717164a8c4c3ac69c507da0a8a6d2e79</sys_id><sys_name>RestQueryHelper</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Boston Startup Tracker" source="x_bst_startuptrk">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_package><sys_scope display_value="Boston Startup Tracker">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_scope><sys_policy/><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_RestResponseBuilder
sys_update_xml.payload:
<record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_bst_startuptrk.RestResponseBuilder</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Builds the total_count pagination envelope, omits fields the caller may not read and returns the prompt 8.0 error bodies.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>RestResponseBuilder</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script>var RestResponseBuilder = Class.create();
RestResponseBuilder.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {
        this.LOG = 'x_bst_startuptrk.RestResponseBuilder';
    },

    /* Serialises one record, omitting every field the caller may not read.
       Implements prompt 3.0 premium field omission. */
    serialize: function (record, fields) {
        var out = {};
        out.sys_id = record.getUniqueValue();
        var i = 0;
        for (i = 0; i !== fields.length; i++) {
            var field = fields[i];
            if (!this.canRead(record, field)) {
                continue;
            }
            out[field] = this.valueOf(record, field);
        }
        return out;
    },

    /* Returns true only when the caller passes the field level read check. */
    canRead: function (record, field) {
        var element = record.getElement(field);
        if (!element) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!element.canRead()) {
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    },

    /* Returns a JSON friendly value for one readable element. */
    valueOf: function (record, field) {
        var element = record.getElement(field);
        var descriptor = element.getED();
        var type = String(descriptor.getInternalType());
        if (type === 'reference') {
            var referenced = record.getValue(field);
            if (!referenced) {
                return null;
            }
            return {
                value: referenced,
                display_value: element.getDisplayValue()
            };
        }
        if (type === 'boolean') {
            return String(record.getValue(field)) === '1';
        }
        if (type === 'integer') {
            var whole = parseInt(record.getValue(field), 10);
            if (isNaN(whole)) {
                return null;
            }
            return whole;
        }
        if (type === 'currency') {
            var money = record.getValue(field);
            if (!money) {
                return null;
            }
            return String(money);
        }
        var plain = record.getValue(field);
        if (plain === null) {
            return null;
        }
        return String(plain);
    },

    /* Builds the paginated envelope. Implements prompt 3.0 total_count. */
    page: function (rows, totalCount, limit, offset) {
        return {
            result: rows,
            total_count: totalCount,
            limit: limit,
            offset: offset
        };
    },

    /* Returns an aggregate count over an encoded query. Implements prompt 3.0. */
    countBy: function (table, encodedQuery) {
        var aggregate = new GlideAggregate(table);
        if (encodedQuery) {
            aggregate.addEncodedQuery(encodedQuery);
        }
        aggregate.addAggregate('COUNT');
        aggregate.query();
        if (aggregate.next()) {
            var total = parseInt(aggregate.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10);
            if (isNaN(total)) {
                return 0;
            }
            return total;
        }
        return 0;
    },

    /* Writes the not found body. Implements prompt 8.0. */
    notFound: function (response, message) {
        response.setStatus(404);
        response.setBody({ error: message });
    },

    /* Writes the bad request body. Implements prompt 8.0. */
    badRequest: function (response, message) {
        response.setStatus(400);
        response.setBody({ error: message });
    },

    /* Writes the server error body and logs the stack trace. Implements prompt 8.0. */
    serverError: function (response, error) {
        var message = 'Internal server error';
        if (error) {
            if (error.message) {
                message = String(error.message);
            }
        }
        var trace = '';
        if (error) {
            if (error.stack) {
                trace = String(error.stack);
            }
        }
        gs.error('[' + this.LOG + '] ' + message + ' ' + trace);
        response.setStatus(500);
        response.setBody({ error: message });
    },

    type: 'RestResponseBuilder'
};</script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_id>877edd48994511bd28a906ba3566b3b7</sys_id><sys_name>RestResponseBuilder</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Boston Startup Tracker" source="x_bst_startuptrk">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_package><sys_scope display_value="Boston Startup Tracker">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_scope><sys_policy/><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_RateLimitService
sys_update_xml.payload:
<record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_bst_startuptrk.RateLimitService</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Per caller fixed window request accounting and the prompt 8.0 rate limit response body with a computed retry_after.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>RateLimitService</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script>var RateLimitService = Class.create();
RateLimitService.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {
        this.TABLE = 'x_bst_startuptrk_rate_limit_counter';
        this.props = new AppProperties();
    },

    /* Records one request and reports whether the caller is over budget.
       Implements prompt 8.0 rate limiting. */
    consume: function (apiResource) {
        var budget = this.props.getRateLimitRequests();
        var windowSeconds = this.props.getRateLimitWindowSeconds();
        var caller = gs.getUserID();
        var windowStart = this._windowStart(windowSeconds);

        var counter = new GlideRecord(this.TABLE);
        counter.addQuery('caller', caller);
        counter.addQuery('api_resource', apiResource);
        counter.addQuery('window_start', windowStart.getValue());
        counter.setLimit(1);
        counter.query();

        var count = 1;
        if (counter.next()) {
            count = parseInt(counter.getValue('request_count'), 10);
            if (isNaN(count)) {
                count = 0;
            }
            count = count + 1;
            counter.setValue('request_count', count);
            counter.update();
        } else {
            var fresh = new GlideRecord(this.TABLE);
            fresh.initialize();
            fresh.setValue('caller', caller);
            fresh.setValue('api_resource', apiResource);
            fresh.setValue('window_start', windowStart.getValue());
            fresh.setValue('request_count', 1);
            fresh.insert();
        }

        var over = false;
        if (count - budget === Math.abs(count - budget)) {
            if (count !== budget) {
                over = true;
            }
        }
        return {
            exceeded: over,
            count: count,
            retry_after: this.retryAfter(windowStart, windowSeconds)
        };
    },

    /* Returns the seconds remaining in the current window. Implements prompt 8.0. */
    retryAfter: function (windowStart, windowSeconds) {
        var expiry = new GlideDateTime(windowStart.getValue());
        expiry.addSeconds(windowSeconds);
        var remaining = gs.dateDiff(new GlideDateTime().getValue(), expiry.getValue(), true);
        var seconds = parseInt(remaining, 10);
        if (isNaN(seconds)) {
            return windowSeconds;
        }
        if (seconds - 1 === -Math.abs(seconds - 1)) {
            return 1;
        }
        return seconds;
    },

    /* Returns the prompt 8.0 rate limit response body. */
    body: function (retryAfter) {
        return {
            error: 'rate_limit_exceeded',
            retry_after: retryAfter
        };
    },

    /* Applies the rate limit to one request. Returns true when the request was
       rejected. Implements prompt 8.0. */
    reject: function (response, apiResource) {
        var state = this.consume(apiResource);
        if (!state.exceeded) {
            return false;
        }
        response.setStatus(429);
        response.setHeader('Retry-After', String(state.retry_after));
        response.setBody(this.body(state.retry_after));
        return true;
    },

    /* Removes counter rows whose window has closed. Implements prompt 8.0. */
    prune: function (retainSeconds) {
        var cutoff = new GlideDateTime();
        cutoff.addSeconds(-Math.abs(retainSeconds));
        var stale = new GlideRecord(this.TABLE);
        stale.addQuery('window_start', 'RELATIVELT', cutoff.getValue());
        stale.query();
        var removed = 0;
        while (stale.next()) {
            stale.deleteRecord();
            removed = removed + 1;
        }
        return removed;
    },

    _windowStart: function (windowSeconds) {
        var now = new GlideDateTime();
        var epoch = Math.floor(now.getNumericValue() / 1000);
        var bucket = epoch - (epoch % windowSeconds);
        var start = new GlideDateTime();
        start.setNumericValue(bucket * 1000);
        return start;
    },

    type: 'RateLimitService'
};</script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_id>1d2deda2fd91c1a00191c1d07a92615b</sys_id><sys_name>RateLimitService</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Boston Startup Tracker" source="x_bst_startuptrk">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_package><sys_scope display_value="Boston Startup Tracker">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_scope><sys_policy/><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_StartupSearchService
sys_update_xml.payload:
<record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_bst_startuptrk.StartupSearchService</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Builds the prompt 1.1 inclusion criteria query and applies the name, industry and location filters for the REST list resource and the portal search widget.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>StartupSearchService</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script>var StartupSearchService = Class.create();
StartupSearchService.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {
        this.TABLE = 'x_bst_startuptrk_startup';
        this.props = new AppProperties();
    },

    /* Builds the inclusion criteria encoded query: active is true and
       headquarters_location contains any configured location token. Implements prompt 1.1. */
    buildInclusionQuery: function () {
        var tokens = this.props.getInclusionLocationTokens();
        var clauses = ['active=true'];
        var i = 0;
        for (i = 0; i !== tokens.length; i++) {
            var clause = 'headquarters_locationLIKE' + tokens[i];
            if (i === 0) {
                clauses.push(clause);
            } else {
                clauses.push('OR' + clause);
            }
        }
        return clauses.join('^');
    },

    /* Adds the caller supplied name, industry and location filters. Implements prompt 3.0. */
    buildFilterQuery: function (filters) {
        var clauses = [];
        if (!filters) {
            return '';
        }
        if (filters.name) {
            clauses.push('nameLIKE' + String(filters.name).trim());
        }
        if (filters.industry) {
            clauses.push('industry=' + String(filters.industry).trim());
        }
        if (filters.location) {
            clauses.push('headquarters_locationLIKE' + String(filters.location).trim());
        }
        return clauses.join('^');
    },

    /* Combines the inclusion criteria with the caller filters. The identical string is
       used for the result set and for the aggregate count. Implements prompt 3.0. */
    buildQuery: function (filters, applyInclusion) {
        var parts = [];
        if (applyInclusion) {
            parts.push(this.buildInclusionQuery());
        }
        var filterQuery = this.buildFilterQuery(filters);
        if (filterQuery !== '') {
            parts.push(filterQuery);
        }
        return parts.join('^');
    },

    /* Returns an ACL respecting result set positioned for iteration.
       Implements prompt 3.0 no ACL bypass. */
    search: function (filters, applyInclusion, limit, offset) {
        var startups = new GlideRecordSecure(this.TABLE);
        var encoded = this.buildQuery(filters, applyInclusion);
        if (encoded !== '') {
            startups.addEncodedQuery(encoded);
        }
        startups.orderBy('name');
        if (limit !== null) {
            startups.chooseWindow(offset, offset + limit);
        }
        startups.query();
        return startups;
    },

    /* Returns true when the caller should see the inclusion filtered set.
       Implements prompt 1.1 admin visibility. */
    appliesInclusion: function () {
        if (gs.hasRole('x_bst_startuptrk.admin')) {
            return false;
        }
        if (gs.hasRole('admin')) {
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    },

    type: 'StartupSearchService'
};</script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_id>a2e07ba24219c51cbe8c1f6507127b65</sys_id><sys_name>StartupSearchService</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Boston Startup Tracker" source="x_bst_startuptrk">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_package><sys_scope display_value="Boston Startup Tracker">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_scope><sys_policy/><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_InvestorPortfolioService
sys_update_xml.payload:
<record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_bst_startuptrk.InvestorPortfolioService</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Derives Investor portfolio_count as the distinct startups reached as lead or participating investor. Implements prompt 1.4.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>InvestorPortfolioService</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script>var InvestorPortfolioService = Class.create();
InvestorPortfolioService.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {
        this.INVESTOR = 'x_bst_startuptrk_investor';
        this.ROUND = 'x_bst_startuptrk_fundinground';
        this.LINK = 'x_bst_startuptrk_m2m_round_investor';
    },

    /* Counts the distinct startups reachable as lead investor or as a participating
       investor, unioning both paths before counting. Implements prompt 1.4. */
    countPortfolio: function (investorId) {
        if (!investorId) {
            return 0;
        }
        var startupIds = {};
        var total = 0;
        var key = '';

        var led = new GlideRecord(this.ROUND);
        led.addQuery('lead_investor', investorId);
        led.query();
        while (led.next()) {
            key = String(led.getValue('startup'));
            if (key !== 'null') {
                if (key !== '') {
                    startupIds[key] = true;
                }
            }
        }

        var roundIds = [];
        var link = new GlideRecord(this.LINK);
        link.addQuery('investor', investorId);
        link.query();
        while (link.next()) {
            var roundId = String(link.getValue('funding_round'));
            if (roundId !== 'null') {
                if (roundId !== '') {
                    roundIds.push(roundId);
                }
            }
        }
        if (roundIds.length !== 0) {
            var participated = new GlideRecord(this.ROUND);
            participated.addQuery('sys_id', 'IN', roundIds.join(','));
            participated.query();
            while (participated.next()) {
                key = String(participated.getValue('startup'));
                if (key !== 'null') {
                    if (key !== '') {
                        startupIds[key] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (key in startupIds) {
            if (startupIds.hasOwnProperty(key)) {
                total = total + 1;
            }
        }
        return total;
    },

    /* Stores the derived count on one investor. Implements prompt 1.4. */
    recalculate: function (investorId) {
        if (!investorId) {
            return false;
        }
        var investor = new GlideRecord(this.INVESTOR);
        if (!investor.get(investorId)) {
            return false;
        }
        var derived = this.countPortfolio(investorId);
        if (String(investor.getValue('portfolio_count')) === String(derived)) {
            return true;
        }
        investor.setValue('portfolio_count', derived);
        investor.update();
        return true;
    },

    /* Recalculates only the investors named, de-duplicated. Implements prompt 1.4. */
    recalculateMany: function (investorIds) {
        var seen = {};
        var i = 0;
        var done = 0;
        for (i = 0; i !== investorIds.length; i++) {
            var id = investorIds[i];
            if (!id) {
                continue;
            }
            id = String(id);
            if (seen[id]) {
                continue;
            }
            seen[id] = true;
            if (this.recalculate(id)) {
                done = done + 1;
            }
        }
        return done;
    },

    /* Recalculates every investor for use after a bulk load. Implements prompt 1.4. */
    recalculateAll: function () {
        var investor = new GlideRecord(this.INVESTOR);
        investor.query();
        var ids = [];
        while (investor.next()) {
            ids.push(investor.getUniqueValue());
        }
        return this.recalculateMany(ids);
    },

    type: 'InvestorPortfolioService'
};</script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_id>b2dd85fad788f85504376a697f958427</sys_id><sys_name>InvestorPortfolioService</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Boston Startup Tracker" source="x_bst_startuptrk">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_package><sys_scope display_value="Boston Startup Tracker">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_scope><sys_policy/><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_IngestionLogger
sys_update_xml.payload:
<record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_bst_startuptrk.IngestionLogger</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Structured ingestion logging with skip the record and continue the run semantics plus the run summary and provenance write. Implements prompt 8.0.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>IngestionLogger</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script>var IngestionLogger = Class.create();
IngestionLogger.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {
        this.SOURCE = 'x_bst_startuptrk.ingestion';
        this.props = new AppProperties();
        this.skipped = 0;
        this.processed = 0;
        this.rejected = 0;
    },

    /* Writes an informational line to the flow execution log. Implements prompt 8.0. */
    info: function (runId, message) {
        gs.info('[' + this.SOURCE + '][' + runId + '] ' + message);
    },

    /* Writes a warning line to the flow execution log. Implements prompt 8.0. */
    warn: function (runId, message) {
        gs.warn('[' + this.SOURCE + '][' + runId + '] ' + message);
    },

    /* Logs a per record failure, counts the skip and lets the run continue.
       Implements prompt 8.0 skip the record and continue the run. */
    skipRecord: function (runId, recordType, identifier, reason) {
        this.skipped = this.skipped + 1;
        gs.error('[' + this.SOURCE + '][' + runId + '] skipped ' + recordType
            + ' ' + identifier + ': ' + reason);
        return true;
    },

    /* Logs a record rejected by the mandatory field rule. Implements prompt 4.0. */
    rejectRecord: function (runId, recordType, identifier, reason) {
        this.rejected = this.rejected + 1;
        gs.warn('[' + this.SOURCE + '][' + runId + '] rejected ' + recordType
            + ' ' + identifier + ': ' + reason);
        return true;
    },

    /* Logs a choice value that matched nothing. Implements prompt 4.0 normalisation. */
    unmatchedChoice: function (runId, field, value) {
        gs.warn('[' + this.SOURCE + '][' + runId + '] unmatched ' + field
            + ' value ' + value + ' normalised to Other');
        return true;
    },

    /* Counts one successfully applied record. */
    countProcessed: function () {
        this.processed = this.processed + 1;
        return this.processed;
    },

    /* Records the provenance of the run and writes the run summary.
       Implements prompt 4.0 provenance and 10.0 criterion 4. */
    writeRunSummary: function (runId, provenance) {
        this.props.setLastRunProvenance(provenance);
        var summary = 'run ' + runId + ' provenance ' + provenance
            + ' processed ' + this.processed
            + ' rejected ' + this.rejected
            + ' skipped ' + this.skipped;
        gs.info('[' + this.SOURCE + '] ' + summary);
        return {
            run: runId,
            provenance: provenance,
            processed: this.processed,
            rejected: this.rejected,
            skipped: this.skipped
        };
    },

    type: 'IngestionLogger'
};</script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_id>d5dbc69de52967616b40eecef86e2895</sys_id><sys_name>IngestionLogger</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Boston Startup Tracker" source="x_bst_startuptrk">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_package><sys_scope display_value="Boston Startup Tracker">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_scope><sys_policy/><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_IngestionMapper
sys_update_xml.payload:
<record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_bst_startuptrk.IngestionMapper</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Applies the four prompt 4.0 cleaning rules and maps staged source payloads onto entity field values.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>IngestionMapper</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script>var IngestionMapper = Class.create();
IngestionMapper.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {
        this.STARTUP = 'x_bst_startuptrk_startup';
        this.logger = new IngestionLogger();
        this.INDUSTRY = ['Fintech', 'Healthtech', 'SaaS', 'Consumer', 'Deeptech', 'Other'];
        this.FUNDING_STAGE = ['Pre-Seed', 'Seed', 'Series A', 'Series B', 'Series C+',
            'Growth', 'Public', 'Acquired'];
        this.MANDATORY = {
            startup: ['name', 'headquarters_location'],
            founder: ['name', 'startup'],
            executive: ['name', 'startup'],
            investor: ['name'],
            funding_round: ['startup', 'round_date'],
            job_posting: ['startup', 'title']
        };
    },

    /* Cleaning rule 1: trims whitespace on every string value. Implements prompt 4.0. */
    trimStrings: function (data) {
        var cleaned = {};
        var key = '';
        for (key in data) {
            if (!data.hasOwnProperty(key)) {
                continue;
            }
            var value = data[key];
            if (typeof value === 'string') {
                cleaned[key] = value.trim();
            } else {
                cleaned[key] = value;
            }
        }
        return cleaned;
    },

    /* Cleaning rule 2: returns the sys_id of an existing startup matching name plus
       headquarters_location case insensitively, or an empty string.
       Implements prompt 4.0 deduplication. */
    findExistingStartup: function (name, headquarters) {
        if (!name) {
            return '';
        }
        var candidate = new GlideRecord(this.STARTUP);
        candidate.addQuery('name', String(name).trim());
        candidate.query();
        var wantedName = String(name).trim().toLowerCase();
        var wantedLocation = String(headquarters ? headquarters : '').trim().toLowerCase();
        while (candidate.next()) {
            var haveName = String(candidate.getValue('name')).trim().toLowerCase();
            var haveLocation = String(candidate.getValue('headquarters_location'))
                .trim().toLowerCase();
            if (haveName === wantedName) {
                if (haveLocation === wantedLocation) {
                    return candidate.getUniqueValue();
                }
            }
        }
        return '';
    },

    /* Cleaning rule 2 helper: de-duplicates a batch on name plus headquarters_location.
       Implements prompt 4.0 deduplication. */
    dedupeBatch: function (rows) {
        var seen = {};
        var unique = [];
        var i = 0;
        for (i = 0; i !== rows.length; i++) {
            var row = rows[i];
            var key = String(row.name ? row.name : '').trim().toLowerCase()
                + '|' + String(row.headquarters_location ? row.headquarters_location : '')
                    .trim().toLowerCase();
            if (seen[key]) {
                continue;
            }
            seen[key] = true;
            unique.push(row);
        }
        return unique;
    },

    /* Cleaning rule 3: normalises a value to the enumerated list, mapping an unmatched
       value to Other and logging it. Implements prompt 4.0 normalisation. */
    normaliseChoice: function (runId, field, value, allowed) {
        var raw = String(value ? value : '').trim();
        var i = 0;
        for (i = 0; i !== allowed.length; i++) {
            if (raw === allowed[i]) {
                return raw;
            }
        }
        for (i = 0; i !== allowed.length; i++) {
            if (raw.toLowerCase() === allowed[i].toLowerCase()) {
                return allowed[i];
            }
        }
        this.logger.unmatchedChoice(runId, field, raw);
        return 'Other';
    },

    /* Normalises an industry value. Implements prompt 4.0. */
    normaliseIndustry: function (runId, value) {
        return this.normaliseChoice(runId, 'industry', value, this.INDUSTRY);
    },

    /* Normalises a funding stage or round type value. Implements prompt 4.0. */
    normaliseFundingStage: function (runId, field, value) {
        return this.normaliseChoice(runId, field, value, this.FUNDING_STAGE);
    },

    /* Cleaning rule 4: reports the mandatory fields a record is missing.
       Implements prompt 4.0 rejection of partial records. */
    missingMandatory: function (recordType, data) {
        var required = this.MANDATORY[recordType];
        var missing = [];
        if (!required) {
            return missing;
        }
        var i = 0;
        for (i = 0; i !== required.length; i++) {
            var field = required[i];
            var value = data[field];
            if (value === null) {
                missing.push(field);
                continue;
            }
            if (value === undefined) {
                missing.push(field);
                continue;
            }
            if (String(value).trim() === '') {
                missing.push(field);
            }
        }
        return missing;
    },

    /* Applies all four cleaning rules to one incoming record. Returns an accepted flag,
       the cleaned data and the rejection reason. Implements prompt 4.0. */
    clean: function (runId, recordType, data) {
        var cleaned = this.trimStrings(data);
        if (cleaned.industry) {
            cleaned.industry = this.normaliseIndustry(runId, cleaned.industry);
        }
        if (cleaned.funding_stage) {
            cleaned.funding_stage = this.normaliseFundingStage(runId, 'funding_stage',
                cleaned.funding_stage);
        }
        if (cleaned.round_type) {
            cleaned.round_type = this.normaliseFundingStage(runId, 'round_type',
                cleaned.round_type);
        }
        var missing = this.missingMandatory(recordType, cleaned);
        if (missing.length !== 0) {
            this.logger.rejectRecord(runId, recordType,
                String(cleaned.name ? cleaned.name : cleaned.title),
                'missing mandatory ' + missing.join(' '));
            return { accepted: false, data: cleaned, reason: 'missing mandatory ' + missing.join(' ') };
        }
        return { accepted: true, data: cleaned, reason: '' };
    },

    /* Maps one staging row onto entity field values. Implements prompt 4.0. */
    mapStagingRow: function (staging) {
        var recordType = String(staging.getValue('record_type'));
        var data = { record_type: recordType };
        if (recordType === 'startup') {
            data.name = staging.getValue('startup_name');
            data.headquarters_location = staging.getValue('headquarters_location');
            data.description = staging.getValue('description');
            data.industry = staging.getValue('industry');
            data.founded_year = staging.getValue('founded_year');
            data.website = staging.getValue('startup_website');
            data.logo_url = staging.getValue('logo_url');
            data.funding_stage = staging.getValue('funding_stage');
            data.total_funding_usd = staging.getValue('total_funding_usd');
            data.active = staging.getValue('startup_active');
            data.institutional_funding_last_5yrs =
                staging.getValue('institutional_funding_last_5yrs');
            data.employee_count_range = staging.getValue('employee_count_range');
            return data;
        }
        if (recordType === 'founder') {
            data.name = staging.getValue('person_name');
            data.title = staging.getValue('person_title');
            data.bio = staging.getValue('bio');
            data.linkedin_url = staging.getValue('linkedin_url');
            data.contact_email = staging.getValue('contact_email');
            data.startup = staging.getValue('startup_name');
            return data;
        }
        if (recordType === 'executive') {
            data.name = staging.getValue('person_name');
            data.title = staging.getValue('person_title');
            data.bio = staging.getValue('bio');
            data.linkedin_url = staging.getValue('linkedin_url');
            data.contact_email = staging.getValue('contact_email');
            data.startup = staging.getValue('startup_name');
            return data;
        }
        if (recordType === 'investor') {
            data.name = staging.getValue('investor_name');
            data.type = staging.getValue('investor_type');
            data.focus_areas = staging.getValue('focus_areas');
            data.website = staging.getValue('investor_website');
            data.aum_usd = staging.getValue('aum_usd');
            return data;
        }
        if (recordType === 'funding_round') {
            data.startup = staging.getValue('startup_name');
            data.round_type = staging.getValue('round_type');
            data.amount_usd = staging.getValue('amount_usd');
            data.round_date = staging.getValue('round_date');
            data.lead_investor = staging.getValue('lead_investor_name');
            data.participating_investors =
                staging.getValue('participating_investor_names');
            data.valuation_usd = staging.getValue('valuation_usd');
            data.source_url = staging.getValue('source_url');
            return data;
        }
        if (recordType === 'job_posting') {
            data.startup = staging.getValue('startup_name');
            data.title = staging.getValue('job_title');
            data.department = staging.getValue('department');
            data.location = staging.getValue('job_location');
            data.remote_type = staging.getValue('remote_type');
            data.seniority = staging.getValue('seniority');
            data.posted_date = staging.getValue('posted_date');
            data.url = staging.getValue('job_url');
            data.active = staging.getValue('job_active');
            return data;
        }
        return data;
    },

    type: 'IngestionMapper'
};</script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_id>fa3775734da5655ff4ad2e30ba2cf39f</sys_id><sys_name>IngestionMapper</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Boston Startup Tracker" source="x_bst_startuptrk">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_package><sys_scope display_value="Boston Startup Tracker">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_scope><sys_policy/><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

        var helper = new RestQueryHelper();
        var limit = helper.getLimit(request);
        var offset = helper.getOffset(request);

        var clauses = [];
        var startup = helper.getParam(request, 'startup');
        if (startup !== '') {
            clauses.push('startup=' + startup);
        }
        var name = helper.getParam(request, 'name');
        if (name !== '') {
            clauses.push('nameLIKE' + name);
        }
        var encoded = clauses.join('^');
        var total = builder.countBy('x_bst_startuptrk_founder', encoded);
        var records = new GlideRecordSecure('x_bst_startuptrk_founder');
        if (encoded !== '') {
            records.addEncodedQuery(encoded);
        }
        records.chooseWindow(offset, offset + limit);
        records.query();
        var rows = [];
        while (records.next()) {
            var row = builder.serialize(records, fields);
            rows.push(row);
        }
        response.setStatus(200);
        response.setBody(builder.page(rows, total, limit, offset));
    } catch (error) {
        builder.serverError(response, error);
    }

Implements prompt 3.0.</description><http_method>GET</http_method><name>Investor list</name><operation_script>(function process(request, response) {
    var builder = new RestResponseBuilder();
    var limiter = new RateLimitService();
    if (limiter.reject(response, '/investors')) {
        return;
    }
    try {
        var helper = new RestQueryHelper();
        var limit = helper.getLimit(request);
        var offset = helper.getOffset(request);
        var fields = ['name', 'type', 'focus_areas', 'website', 'aum_usd', 'portfolio_count'];
        var clauses = [];
        var name = helper.getParam(request, 'name');
        if (name !== '') {
            clauses.push('nameLIKE' + name);
        }
        var type = helper.getParam(request, 'type');
        if (type !== '') {
            clauses.push('type=' + type);
        }
        var encoded = clauses.join('^');
        var total = builder.countBy('x_bst_startuptrk_investor', encoded);
        var records = new GlideRecordSecure('x_bst_startuptrk_investor');
        if (encoded !== '') {
            records.addEncodedQuery(encoded);
        }
        records.chooseWindow(offset, offset + limit);
        records.query();
        var rows = [];
        while (records.next()) {
            var row = builder.serialize(records, fields);
            rows.push(row);
        }
        response.setStatus(200);
        response.setBody(builder.page(rows, total, limit, offset));
    } catch (error) {
        builder.serverError(response, error);
    }
})(request, response);</operation_script><operation_uri>/api/x_bst_startuptrk/v1/investors</operation_uri><produces>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</produces><produces_customized>false</produces_customized><relative_path>/investors</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>true</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>false</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description>Returns a paginated investor list carrying total_count.         link.addQuery('funding_round', roundId);
        link.query();
        while (link.next()) {
            var investorId = link.getValue('investor');
            if (investorId) {
                names.push({
                    value: investorId,
                    display_value: link.investor.getDisplayValue()
                });
            }
        }
        return names;
    }
        var helper = new RestQueryHelper();

    var builder = new RestResponseBuilder();
    var limiter = new RateLimitService();
    if (limiter.reject(response, '/news')) {
        return;
    }
    try {
        var helper = new RestQueryHelper();
        var limit = helper.getLimit(request);
        var offset = helper.getOffset(request);
        var fields = ['startup', 'title', 'source', 'url', 'published_date', 'summary'];
        var clauses = [];
        var startup = helper.getParam(request, 'startup');
        if (startup !== '') {
            clauses.push('startup=' + startup);
        }
        var source = helper.getParam(request, 'source');
        if (source !== '') {
            clauses.push('source=' + source);
        }
        var encoded = clauses.join('^');
        var total = builder.countBy('x_bst_startuptrk_newsarticle', encoded);
        var records = new GlideRecordSecure('x_bst_startuptrk_newsarticle');
        if (encoded !== '') {
            records.addEncodedQuery(encoded);
        }
        records.chooseWindow(offset, offset + limit);
        records.query();
        var rows = [];
        while (records.next()) {
            var row = builder.serialize(records, fields);
            rows.push(row);
        }
        response.setStatus(200);
        response.setBody(builder.page(rows, total, limit, offset));
    } catch (error) {
        builder.serverError(response, error);
    }

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_recalculate_investor_portfolio_on_funding_round
sys_update_xml.payload:
<record_update table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>true</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_bst_startuptrk_fundinground</collection><condition/><description>Delegates Investor portfolio_count recalculation to InvestorPortfolioService for the previous and the new lead investor and for every linked participating investor. Implements prompt 1.4.</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><is_rest>false</is_rest><name>Recalculate investor portfolio on funding round</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><script>(function executeRule(current, previous) {
    var service = new InvestorPortfolioService();
    var affected = [];
    affected.push(current.getValue('lead_investor'));
    if (previous) {
        affected.push(previous.getValue('lead_investor'));
    }
    var links = new GlideRecord('x_bst_startuptrk_m2m_round_investor');
    links.addQuery('funding_round', current.getUniqueValue());
    links.query();
    while (links.next()) {
        affected.push(links.getValue('investor'));
    }
    service.recalculateMany(affected);
})(current, previous);</script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_id>e818e5e8cba9e7a3ea0ec7b252855b3a</sys_id><sys_name>Recalculate investor portfolio on funding round</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Boston Startup Tracker" source="x_bst_startuptrk">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_package><sys_scope display_value="Boston Startup Tracker">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_scope><sys_policy/><template/><when>after</when><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on></sys_script></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_trim_and_validate_startup
sys_update_xml.payload:
<record_update table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_bst_startuptrk_startup</collection><condition/><description>Trims whitespace on Startup string fields and rejects records missing a mandatory name or headquarters location. Implements prompt 4.0 cleaning rules 1 and 4.</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><is_rest>false</is_rest><name>Trim and validate startup</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><script>(function executeRule(current, previous) {
    var trimmable = ['name', 'description', 'headquarters_location', 'website',
        'logo_url', 'industry', 'funding_stage', 'employee_count_range'];
    var i = 0;
    for (i = 0; i !== trimmable.length; i++) {
        var field = trimmable[i];
        var value = current.getValue(field);
        if (value === null) {
            continue;
        }
        var trimmed = String(value).trim();
        if (trimmed !== String(value)) {
            current.setValue(field, trimmed);
        }
    }
    if (String(current.getValue('name')).trim() === '') {
        gs.addErrorMessage(gs.getMessage('Startup name is required.'));
        current.setAbortAction(true);
        return;
    }
    if (String(current.getValue('headquarters_location')).trim() === '') {
        gs.addErrorMessage(gs.getMessage('Startup headquarters location is required.'));
        current.setAbortAction(true);
    }
})(current, previous);</script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_id>db47106f01240b829205ce83010abe5d</sys_id><sys_name>Trim and validate startup</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Boston Startup Tracker" source="x_bst_startuptrk">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_package><sys_scope display_value="Boston Startup Tracker">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_scope><sys_policy/><template/><when>before</when><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on></sys_script></record_update>

    var properties = new AppProperties();
    var windowSeconds = properties.getRateLimitWindowSeconds();
    var limiter = new RateLimitService();
    var removed = limiter.prune(windowSeconds * 60);
    gs.info('[x_bst_startuptrk.prune_rate_limit_counters] removed ' + removed
        + ' closed window rows');
})();</script><sys_class_name>sysauto_script</sys_class_name><sys_id>f8e4054aa6edd8b63bf0b1a333f3e244</sys_id><sys_name>Prune rate limit counters</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Boston Startup Tracker" source="x_bst_startuptrk">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_package><sys_scope display_value="Boston Startup Tracker">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_scope><time_zone/><upgrade_safe>false</upgrade_safe><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on></sysauto_script></record_update>
